notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
[h3]Update Contents:[/h3]

[olist]
[*] Added Endless Mode: Challenge randomly generated stages for endless fun!
[*] New Challenge Mode in Endless Mode: Try to clear as many random stages as possible within 30 minutes—test your skills to the limit!
[*] Added Input Delay Setting: Adjust the input delay in the settings if the movement feels too fast, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.
[/olist]
[b]Thank you for your support, and enjoy the game![/b]

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
Level Editor  
1. Fixed a bug where 'Q' and 'R' could not be entered in the level name.  
2. Fixed a bug where the radial menu could still be opened with a right-click during level testing.  
3. Fixed a bug where some text was not displayed in the radial menu.  
4. Fixed a bug where language locales was not working in the radial menu.  
5. Prevented the deletion of red pellet (player control) and green pellet (level target) to avoid accidental deletion.  
6. Fixed a bug where objects could be dragged and stacked together on the same layer.  
7. Disabled the right-click menu in text input fields.  
8. Fixed a bug with the cursor position in number input fields.  
9. Fixed a bug where non-numeric characters could be entered in number input fields.  
10. Allowed users to input negative numbers in numeric properties.  
11. Adjusted the layout of some buttons to the top menu.  
12. Changed the save and publish mechanism for editing.  
13. Added a help tutorial in the editor (currently only supports English and Chinese).  
Other  
14. Pressing the [Esc] key now exits the level/editor (previously the [Q] key).  
15. Changed the multiplication and division characters in level hints to more readable characters.  
16. Fixed hints in some levels.

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where holding down the direction key during the animation of entering or resetting a level would cause double moves. (Thanks to Aruket for the feedback)

Fixed a bug where the level cover screenshot in the Workshop would shift at some resolutions.

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that the game has received its latest update! Here are the main contents of this update:

1. Added Undo Feature: You can now enable or disable the undo function in the game options, making your gaming experience more flexible. (Use 'U' Key to undo a step)

2. Added Operator Explanations: Detailed explanations about operators have been added to the early levels of the game, particularly addressing the directional issues with division and subtraction that many players have mentioned.

3. Support for Continuous Movement by Holding Direction Keys: You can now hold down the direction keys to move continuously, making controls more convenient.

4. Fixed Penetration Issue: Fix the penetration issue that could occur during the transfer and swap mechanism animations, improving the stability and experience of the game.

5. Fix division by zero.

6. Adjust level 12 and 15.

Thank you for your continuous support and passion.

notes.title: Pricing issue resolved
notes.content:
Dear Players,

I am pleased to inform you that, with the assistance of the Steam support team, the pricing issue on the game's store page has now been resolved.

The game is released as free-to-play, and you can now access and download it without any issues. 

Thank you for your support and patience.  

2025-2-20

notes.title: About the pricing bug on Steam
notes.content:
Dear All,

I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the pricing bug on Steam, which prevented you from purchasing and accessing the game. I deeply regret the frustration and inconvenience this has caused you.

This is my first time releasing a game on Steam, so I'm not familiar with the Steamworks operations. I set a price for the game when creating the store page, but decided to change it to free-to-play during the beta test. I'm not sure if I made a mistake when changing the price settings, or if there were other reasons that caused the issue. 

Currently, the game appears as free when searched, but the store page displays a price. However, when you attempt to purchase it, the payment cannot be processed. I believe this might be caused by some kind of bug.

I'm already in contact with Steam support to resolve this issue as quickly as possible. We will fix the error promptly to ensure you can enjoy the game.

Thank you again for your understanding and support. 

Sheep_Games

2025-2-17
